mapper.insert: INSERT INTO derive_story_obligation ( run_id, obligation_key, chapter_no, kind, target_key, required, forbidden, severity, source_contract, status, payload ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.obligationKey}, #{p.chapterNo}, #{p.kind}, #{p.targetKey}, COALESCE(#{p.required}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{p.forbidden}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{p.severity}, 'HARD'), #{p.sourceContract}, COALESCE(#{p.status}, 'PLANNED'), #{p.payload}::jsonb )
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, obligation_key, chapter_no, kind, target_key, required, forbidden, severity, source_contract, status, payload, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_story_obligation WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY chapter_no, obligation_key
